summary: Finalized web-extension build integration with shared json-render dependencies: added and pinned @json-render/core, @json-render/svelte to 0.20.0 and zod to 4.4.3, made the web-extension builder proxy the host's shared default export (falling back to `host.default ?? host`), documented usage and custom-registry build requirements in docs/extensions.md, and verified 213 app tests, svelte-check, production build, and prettier all pass.
decisions: Pin @json-render/core and @json-render/svelte to version 0.20.0 and zod to 4.4.3 as explicit dependencies so the web-extension builder can reuse the host's copies instead of bundling its own.
Web-extension build emits an entry whose default export is `host.default ?? host`, ensuring it re-exports whatever the actual package module exports when Node-loadable.
Reinstall with `--frozen-lockfile --config.optimistic-repeat-install=false` was used to keep dependencies at their original pinned versions rather than letting pnpm upgrade them to `latest`.
Repository-wide `pnpm check` is deliberately not fixed in this segment; the three dead data-ui CSS hooks in shell-parts/resize-and-navigation.css are noted as pre-existing and unrelated.
errors: Repository-wide `pnpm check` failed with exit code 1 because three data-ui hooks (`window-control`, `window-controls`, and one other) are styled in apps/app/src/styles/shell-parts/resize-and-navigation.css but have no markup use; treated as unrelated to this change.
